source: Counts, factions and deck use are from the game's card data (1,351 cards). The descriptions are read from the cards and the fan rulebook and have not been traced through the game's code.

types.name: Normal
types.text: An ordinary stratagem. Use this unless another card needs to pick yours out as part of a family.

types.name: Offensive Card
types.text: The Offence cards the player going first chooses from at the start of a battle (39), plus 52 internal helper cards for their lasting effects. Handled outside the deck.

types.name: Defensive Card
types.text: The Defence card saved with a deck and used when going second. Chosen in the deck editor's own slot, not in the card list.

types.name: Psychic Power
types.text: Created during play. Removed at end of turn if unused.

types.name: Mark Of Chaos
types.text: The four god marks, applied to a unit as lasting effects.

types.name: Secret
types.text: Shuffled into your deck by Quest.

types.name: Sabotage
types.text: Created in the opponent's hand by the Sabotage keyword.

types.name: Rune
types.text: Created during play. Removed at end of turn if unused.

types.name: Codicil
types.text: Created during play. Removed at end of turn if unused.
